# gads CLI

A Google Ads / Google platform CLI built for agent-driven automation.

## Discovery

> Run `tools/gads catalog --json` to get the full command/parameter manifest.
> This is the canonical entry point — do not hardcode command lists.

## Reference

- AGENTS.md — full capability index, output contract, exit codes, mutation discipline
- `tools/gads --help` — top-level usage
- `tools/gads <command> --help` — per-command usage

## v3.9.0 New Commands

### Merchant Center
`gads merchant register-gcp -e EMAIL [--account ID] [--json]`
Registers the GCP OAuth project with Merchant Center (fixes GCP_NOT_REGISTERED).
POST to developerRegistration:registerGcp. One-time setup; wait ~5 min after.



7 new read-only gap checks under `gads analyze`:
- `rsa-lengths` — headlines < 20 or descriptions < 60 chars
- `rsa-duplicates` — intra-RSA duplicate headline detection
- `dki` — Dynamic Keyword Insertion presence/absence
- `ad-schedule` — SEARCH campaigns missing dayparting rules
- `attribution` — Last-Click conversion action flag
- `budget-is` — search_budget_lost_impression_share > 10%
- `qs-distribution` — QS sub-signal ABOVE/AVERAGE/BELOW band breakdown

New top-level command: `gads audit [--days N] [--format md|json]`
Runs the full 12-section compliance audit. `--format json` for agent pipelines.

## New Commands (2026-09-04)

Performance Max (read-only, new `pmax` group — distinct from `asset`):
- `gads pmax asset-groups [--campaign ID]` — status, ad strength, performance
- `gads pmax signals [--campaign ID]` — audience + search-theme signals
- `gads pmax listing-groups [--campaign ID]` — listing group filters (product partitions)
- `gads pmax search-terms --campaign ID [--days N]` — search-term category insights (`--campaign` required)

Shopping and Merchant reports:
- `gads report shopping [--days N]` — per-SKU Shopping performance (`shopping_performance_view`)
- `gads merchant report -q "..."` — Merchant reports sub-API escape hatch (own SQL-like dialect, NOT GAQL)
- `gads merchant report-product-performance [--days N]` — canned per-SKU clicks/impressions/CTR (no cost; free-traffic conversions only)

Account-level negative keywords (blocks a term in EVERY campaign, vs. campaign-level `keyword negative`):
- `gads keyword account-negative list`
- `gads keyword account-negative add TEXT [-m EXACT|PHRASE|BROAD]`

Behavior change: `gads batch-mutate` now sends `partialFailure=true` — a partially-failed batch
applies its successful operations instead of being rejected atomically, and exits non-zero.

New env vars: `GADS_HTTP_RETRIES` (max attempts, default 4), `GADS_HTTP_TIMEOUT` (seconds, default 30).

Retry semantics: 429 is always retried (a throttled request was never processed). 5xx, connection
errors and timeouts are retried only for idempotent calls. Idempotency is fail-closed — a POST is
treated as a mutation and NOT retried unless its URL is on an explicit read allowlist. Backoff is
exponential with jitter, capped at 60s per sleep, and honours `Retry-After`.

Auth two-step (headless/WSL, no local listener):
`gads auth login --print-url-only` → open URL, grant → `gads auth login --callback-url '<pasted URL>'`
(or `--code '<code>'`). `--port` (default 9090) must match both steps. Scope-regression guard applies.

Merchant pagination: `merchant products` / `product-status` page the FULL catalogue (pageSize=1000,
follow nextPageToken, 100-page cap). `--limit` trims the printed table only; `--json` is always
complete and carries `truncated`. Merchant reports use MCQL, not GAQL.

## Account

- Client: Talas Ads (355-285-6345)
- Manager: 670-695-5825
- Currency: AED | API version: v24 (pinned; upstream GA is v25.1 as of 2026-09-04, v24 sunsets May 2027)

## Command count

129 command paths across 18 groups + 16 top-level commands, of which 6 (`ads query|perf|config|
refresh|snapshot|log`) are aliases — 123 distinct commands. `gads catalog --json` is authoritative;
do not hardcode this number.

## Also see mads-cli

For Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads — Marketing API, Conversions API, Commerce Manager — the sister
CLI: https://github.com/talas9/mads-cli
